queries_run: MercadoLibre business model shift 2026 Meli+ subscription first-party 1P 3P fulfillment

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025：平台仍以第三方賣家(3P)為主，自營(1P)在選定品類補強、占 GMV 不到 10%；Meli+ 忠誠／訂閱方案 2025 年擴至阿根廷、智利、哥倫比亞，巴西新增含串流的 Meli+ Mega 訂閱層。
findings.excerpt: Third-party sellers (“3P”) account for most of the GMV transacted on the Marketplace. We complement this by selling directly to consumers on a first-party basis (“1P”) in selected categories where we can enhance price competitiveness and assortment; this accounts for less than 10% of GMV.

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025：Meli+ 新版採分層結構，Total 層含 Disney+，巴西新增 Meli+ Mega 單一訂閱整合 Netflix、Disney+、HBO Max、Apple TV+（訂閱化持續擴張）。
findings.excerpt: In Brazil, we introduced a new subscription tier, Meli+ Mega, which consolidates multiple entertainment services into a unique single-subscription bundle, offering access to streaming platforms such as Netflix, Disney+, HBO Max and Apple TV+.

findings.claim: Zacks 報導：1P 快速擴張，2026Q1 1P GMV 外匯中性 +69%，毛利率下滑約 300bp，毛利率恢復受壓。
findings.source: Zacks／MetaTrader：MercadoLibre Expands 1P Rapidly: Is Margin Recovery at Risk?
findings.excerpt: The company's 1P gross merchandise volume grew 69% year over year on a foreign exchange-neutral basis in the first quarter of 2026, significantly outpacing overall marketplace growth.
